methodology_other:
Two dataset have been provided:

31Adist_polbnda_adm4_MoFALD_HRRP_wgs84: Admin4 level boundaries based on new VDCs as defined by Ministry of Federal Affairs and Local Development (MoFALD) through LGCDP project for 31 districts affected by Nepal Earthquake 2015.
	
160822_31dist_SpatialCode_Conversion.xlsx: The code reference sheet (from:HLCIT_Code to HRRP_VCODE) maps all VDCs in 31 districts including those have been merge to form Municipalities. This should be used, accompanying the "31Adist_polbnda_adm4_MoFALD_HRRP_wgs84" shapefiles, to convert the datasets from prior adm 4 level to new adm4 level.

31Adist_polbnda_adm4_MoFALD_HRRP_wgs84: Admin3 level boundaries as defined by MoFALD through LGCDP project for 31 affected districts .
